name: Viktor Mensah
headline: Software Developer
summary: Software Developer who builds reliable backend services and improves release workflows across product teams. Experienced in REST APIs, Spring Boot, microservices delivery, and cloud-native deployment practices. Known for shipping maintainable systems, tightening automated checks, and supporting teams through fast-moving product changes.

roles.title: Software Developer
bullets: Built REST APIs and service endpoints in Scala and Spring Boot, improving response consistency across core backend workflows.
Deployed services on Kubernetes and tuned rollout steps so the team could ship updates with fewer interruptions.
Worked with product and support teams to refine backend behavior and reduce recurring defects by 18%.
Expanded internal service logic in Scala while keeping integration points stable for downstream consumers.

roles.title: Software Developer
bullets: Developed Microservices in Kotlin with Spring Boot and REST APIs, supporting a faster path from feature design to release.
Set up Azure delivery environments and containerized services with Docker, reducing environment drift across the team.
Maintained Git workflows and GitHub Actions pipelines to automate checks and keep merges predictable for 12 active repositories.
Wrote JUnit test suites for Spring Boot services and improved defect detection before release by 24%.
Reviewed code changes with peers and coordinated small backend improvements that kept service behavior aligned across Microservices.

projects.name: Pocket Compass
projects.description: Designed Pocket Compass as a set of Microservices with GitHub Actions to support frequent integration and release steps.
